prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='catboost', seasonality_champion='NaiveMovingAverage', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: Multiple models achieve perfect trend correlation (1.0), with catboost selected as trend champion due to its superior overall RMSE (31.76) among tied models. NaiveMovingAverage leads in seasonal correlation (0.624) despite poor overall performance. High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 26.3) and seasonality variance suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition-aware combination while handling concept drift and residual autocorrelation.
